notes.title: Added integration of capybara items with the trading platform!
notes.content:
Dear capybaras!
Items for the trading floor can be obtained as follows:

 You can get a random item every 4 hours by logging into the game.
 You can get an item every 24 hours if you can climb a mountain!
 We have also added the ability to get an item if you have DLC.


P.S. Please note that it may take more than a minute to receive the item and you cannot minimize the game.

We've also fix performance issues:

 We optimized the rendering performance, achieving a 30% increase in frame rate.
 We optimized materials and texture sizes to reduce memory consumption of graphics cards.
 We also optimized the load of the rope computation on the CPU
 We've reduced the weight of our game by 15%

notes.title: Small update, 17 may, 2024
notes.content:
Dear capybaras!


 Improved camera behavior and fixed objects that could block its view.
 Fixed possible places to get stuck in Egypt, City, sci-fi levels.


Thank you for your attention!

notes.title: Fixing bugs that were noticed by players
notes.content:
Hello, we were able to detect and fix the following bugs:

 Fixing mouse sensitivity issue.
 Fixed a bug with the inability to control the mouse at the end of the game.
 Adjusted the reload time and speed of lasers on sci-fi and final levels.
 The shape of the moving platform has been changed to make it easier to climb onto the rock.
 New music appeared at the end of the game.
 Fixed various potential places for capybaras to get stuck in all levels.

Thank you for your attention!
